description: 高耸角盔下是青绿色面甲，宽大棱角肩甲保留深铁色金属质感。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Mordekaiser is an enormous fully armored figure with dark iron plates, a tall horned helmet, glowing teal visor openings, broad angular shoulders, and a heavy cape-like metal silhouette. Preserve the closed nonordinary armored identity without exposing a human face, skeletal remains, or wounds. His massive spiked mace rests head-down on stone beside him, held motionless by the shaft rather than raised threateningly.
art_direction.scene: A balanced near-frontal full character, subtle contrapposto if anatomically appropriate, silhouette opening into a large quiet paper field. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: iron, restrained teal, lilac pencil shadow violet, pale copper light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
